name: Processor_A_5Q_Branching_Tree
description: 5-qubit branching-tree processor (nodes 0-4). Primary topology for QFF 2026 Phase 1 Processor A benchmarking.
custom_ring_description: Alternative 5-qubit ring topology for creative coupling-map freedom analysis. All 5 qubits are connected in a cycle, providing uniform connectivity vs the branching tree.
optimal_4q_subgraph_description: Best 4-qubit subgraph for ZZFeatureMap embedding on the branching-tree topology (path chain 0-1-2-3 or 0-1-3-4).

noise_params.description: Frozen QFF 2026 synthetic noise: 1Q depolarizing p=0.001 on [rz,sx,x], 2Q depolarizing p=0.005 on [cx], symmetric readout error p=0.01 on all qubits.
